scripts.text:
[Mr. Claus]
Ho Ho Ho~
Merry Christmas!!
I wish all of you joy
and Christmas cheer!
scripts.translation:
[克劳斯先生]

喔喔喔~

圣诞快乐！！

祝愿大家都能收获喜悦

并沉浸在圣诞的欢庆氛围中！

scripts.text: Info about Lutie
scripts.translation: 关于姜饼城的信息

scripts.text: Move to 'Lutie'
scripts.translation: 前往“姜饼城”

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Mr. Claus]
^3355FFLutie^000000, the fantastic Christmas Town! Always filled with the spirit of giving, Lutie is filled with appetizing cakes, tiny toy soldiers, and all sorts of wonderful things~!
scripts.translation:
[克劳斯先生]

^3355FF姜饼城^000000，那座梦幻的圣诞城镇！姜饼城始终洋溢着奉献的精神，到处都是美味的蛋糕、小小的玩具士兵，以及各种各样奇妙的事物~！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Claus]
Ho Ho Ho~
It's an amazing land blessed with the beauty of winter, and a year round atmosphere of festivity!
scripts.translation:
[克劳斯先生]

喔喔喔~

这是一片被冬日之美所祝福的奇妙土地，全年都沉浸在节日的气氛之中！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Claus]
I'm a Santa that will guide people to Lutie, the Christmas Town. Ask me at any time, and I'll magically send you there~
scripts.translation:
[克劳斯先生]

我是会引导人们前往圣诞城镇——姜饼城的圣诞老人。随时来问我吧，我会用魔法把你送过去的~

scripts.text:
[Mr. Claus]
Ho Ho Ho~
The only way to get to Lutie is here in Al de Baran!
scripts.translation:
[克劳斯先生]

喔喔喔~

前往姜饼城的唯一途径就在这片阿尔德巴兰！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Claus]
I keep this place and personally transport people who want to visit Lutie. Please ask Santa Claus over there if you want to leave town. He will let you know the way out of Lutie.
scripts.translation:
[克劳斯先生]

我负责守护这里，并亲自运送想要前往姜饼城的人。如果你想离开城镇，请去询问那边的圣诞老人。他会告诉你离开姜饼城的路线。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Claus]
Ho Ho Ho~
Well, are you ready?
Have a nice trip!
Meeeeerry Christmas!
scripts.translation:
[克劳斯先生]

喔喔喔~

好了，准备好了吗？

祝你旅途愉快！

圣诞快乐！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Claus]
Ho Ho Ho~
Whenever you want to visit Lutie, be my guest. Just let me know when you want to leave.
scripts.translation:
[克劳斯先生]

喔喔喔~

无论你想什么时候去姜饼城，随时欢迎。只要在你想离开的时候告诉我一声就行。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Claus]
Ho ho hooooo!!
Haaaaappy Holidays!
scripts.translation:
[克劳斯先生]

喔喔喔喔喔喔！！

节日快乐！

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
Ho Ho Ho~
Meeeerry Christmas !!
scripts.translation:
[圣诞老人]

喔喔喔~

圣诞快乐！！

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt's...^000000
^3355FFIt's the original Santa Claus!^000000

[Santa Claus]
Ho Ho Ho~
I'm Santa Claus, and I bring gifts to every good boy and girl on Christmas!
scripts.translation:
[圣诞老人]

喔喔喔~

我是圣诞老人，在圣诞节时我会为每一个乖巧的孩子带来礼物！

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
If you want to leave Lutie, go outside town and head south to the first field that you see. You'll be able to find a magical warp that will take you to Al de Baran.
scripts.translation:
[圣诞老人]

如果你想离开姜饼城，请走出城镇并向南前往你看到的第一个地图。在那里你会发现一个魔法传送点，能把你送回阿尔德巴兰。

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
Ho ho ho~
Meeeeeeerry Christmas!
scripts.translation:
[圣诞老人]

喔喔喔~

圣诞快乐！

scripts.text:
[Duffle]
Merry Christmas!
Welcome to Lutie!
scripts.translation:
[达夫尔]

圣诞快乐！

欢迎来到姜饼城！

scripts.text:
[Duffle]
You got a present
from Santa Claus?!
Ha ha, you must
be really excited!
scripts.translation:
[达夫尔]

你收到

圣诞老人的礼物了吗？！

哈哈，你一定

超级兴奋吧！

scripts.text:
[Duffle]
Hey, have you heard that here in Lutie, we have an attraction that's equally as famous as Santa himself?
scripts.translation:
[达夫尔]

嘿，你听说过吗？在姜饼城，我们有一个和圣诞老人一样出名的景点哦？

scripts.text:
[Duffle]
It's ^3355FFSnowysnow^000000,
the magical
talking snowman!
scripts.translation:
[达夫尔]

那就是 ^3355FF雪之雪^000000，

那个会说话的

神奇雪人！

scripts.text:
[Duffle]
Before you leave, you really should meet and talk to Snowysnow, even if it's only once. He's really a nice guy and fun to talk to.
scripts.translation:
[达夫尔]
在你离开之前，你真的应该去见见雪雪并和他聊聊，哪怕只有一次也好。他真的是个很棒的人，聊天也很有趣。

scripts.text:
[Duffle]
Well then...
Merry Christmas!!
scripts.translation:
[达夫尔]
那么...
圣诞快乐！！

scripts.text:
[Duffle]
Have you ever talked to the snowman in front of this town? The lonely snowman who stands in solitude...
scripts.translation:
[达夫尔]
你有没有和这座城镇前的雪人聊过天？那个孤独地伫立在荒野中的雪人……

scripts.text:
[Duffle]
But he's so warm hearted~! Sometimes, I talk to Snowysnow the snowman. For some weird reason, he can talk just like us!
scripts.translation:
[达夫尔]
但他其实心肠很热呢~！有时候，我会和雪雪聊天。出于某种奇怪的原因，他竟然能像我们一样说话！

scripts.text:
[Duffle]
When I talk to Snowysnow, I get to wondering how he came to be. I guess if you talk to him too, you'll feel the same way.
scripts.translation:
[达夫尔]
当我跟雪雪聊天时，我不禁会好奇他是怎么诞生的。我想如果你也和他聊聊，也会有同样的感觉。

scripts.text:
[Duffle]
How he was created, and how he thinks and talks like a human is such a mystery...
scripts.translation:
[达夫尔]
他是如何被创造出来的，又是如何像人类一样思考和说话的，这真是个谜……

scripts.text:
[Duffle]
Where did he come from and what kind of place was it? And how did he come to Lutie without any legs...?
scripts.translation:
[达夫尔]
他从哪里来，又是从什么样的环境里来的？而且他没有腿，又是怎么来到姜饼城的……？

scripts.text:
[Duffle]
Lately, it seems more and more people are coming to this town to see Snowysnow.
scripts.translation:
[达夫尔]
最近，似乎有越来越多的人来到这座城镇来看雪雪。

scripts.text:
[Duffle]
I guess you should talk to the other people living in Lutie if you want to learn more about the mystery of Snowysnow...
scripts.translation:
[达夫尔]
我想如果你想了解更多关于雪雪之谜的事情，应该去和姜饼城的其他居民聊聊……

scripts.text:
[Duffle]
Oh...!
While you're here, don't forget to visit the original Santa Claus here in Lutie.
scripts.translation:
[达夫尔]
噢...！
既然你都来了，别忘了去拜访一下姜饼城这里正宗的圣诞老人。

scripts.text:
[Thachentze]
Hmm? The Hairy guy
spoke well of me,
did he? Well well...
scripts.translation:
[塔琴策]
嗯？那个毛茸茸的家伙
居然在夸我，
是吗？哎呀呀……

scripts.text:
[Thachentze]
I know what he thinks... Ho ho ho~! He intends to make me feel happy so that I'll give him some free jars of pickles! Oh well~!
scripts.translation:
[塔琴策]
我知道他在想什么……呵呵呵~！他是想让我开心，好让我送他一些免费的腌菜罐头！哎呀~！

scripts.text:
[Thachentze]
He knows me too well. I almost can't stop from giving that man some pickles. Yes, even I know my pickles are the best in town!
scripts.translation:
[塔琴策]
他太了解我了。我简直快要忍不住想送那家伙一些腌菜了。没错，连我也知道我的腌菜是镇上最棒的！

scripts.text:
[Thachentze]
Hmmm~?
You want to know
about ^3355FFSnowysnow^000000?
Oh. Yes, yes, I see...
scripts.translation:
[塔琴策]
嗯~？
你想知道关于^3355FF雪雪^000000的事吗？
噢。是的，是的，我明白了……

scripts.text:
[Thachentze]
Well, I can't just let anyone know something so important about Snowysnow. Hmmm...
scripts.translation:
[塔琴策]
好吧，我不能随便把关于雪雪这么重要的事告诉任何人。嗯……

scripts.text:
[Thachentze]
Snowysnow has been holding something for me as a favor, the ^3355FFroughest salt in the world^000000 which I use to pickle cabbages.
scripts.translation:
[塔琴策]
雪雪为了报答我，一直帮我保管着一样东西，那就是我用来腌卷心菜的^3355FF世界上最粗糙的盐^000000。

scripts.text:
[Thachentze]
I suppose if you're really Snowysnow's friend, he will trust you enough to give it to you so you can deliver it to me. And in any case, I'll need more of it soon.
scripts.translation:
[塔琴策]
我想如果你真的是雪雪的朋友，他应该会足够信任你，把东西交给你去送给我。无论如何，我很快就需要更多盐了。

scripts.text:
[Thachentze]
Now be a dear
and hurry up.
Come back quickly~
scripts.translation:
[塔琴策]
现在请你乖乖地
快点行动吧。
快点回来哦~

scripts.text:
[Thachentze]
Hohohoho~
You're back!
scripts.translation:
[塔琴策]
呵呵呵呵~
你回来啦！

scripts.text:
[Thachentze]
Did you bring it?
Oh goodness...!
My cabbages will
get sour soon!
scripts.translation:
[塔琴策]
你带来了吗？
天哪...！
我的卷心菜
很快就要变酸了！

scripts.text:
[Thachentze]
You...
Don't have it?
scripts.translation:
[塔琴策]
你...
没有吗？

scripts.text:
[Thachentze]
*Sigh*
You are really a scatter-brained person, my dear. Now hurry over to Snowysnow and bring me the ^3355FFroughest salt in the world^000000.
scripts.translation:
[塔琴策]
*唉*
亲爱的，你真是个丢三落四的人。现在快去雪雪那里，帮我带回^3355FF世界上最粗糙的盐^000000。

scripts.text:
[Thachentze]
Hurry now, dear,
Chop Chop~!
scripts.translation:
[塔琴策]
快点，亲爱的，
动作快点～！

scripts.text:
[Thachentze]
Hohohohoh hohohohoho !
Let's see, let's see...
Thank you dear,Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[塔琴策]
呵呵呵呵呵，呵呵呵呵呵！
让我看看，让我看看...
谢谢你，亲爱的，谢谢你。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou gave her the
roughest salt in the world.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你给了她
世界上最粗糙的盐。^000000

scripts.text:
[Thachentze]
Now I am able to pickle my cabbages properly. Thank you, my dear. Thank you...
scripts.translation:
[塔琴策]
现在我终于可以好好腌制我的卷心菜了。谢谢你，亲爱的。谢谢你...

scripts.text:
[Thachentze]
Oh yes, I'm sorry. I almost forgot what I promised you. You asked me about Snowysnow's magical gift bag, didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[塔琴策]
噢对了，抱歉。我差点忘了答应你的事。你之前问过我关于雪雪的魔法礼品袋的事，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Thachentze]
If you already met Uncle Cantata, you must know by now that Snowysnow has been made out of some mysterious snow that covered a thick field of magical flowers.
scripts.translation:
[塔琴策]
如果你已经见过康塔塔叔叔，你现在应该已经知道了，雪雪是由覆盖着大片魔法花田的神秘积雪所化成的。

scripts.text:
[Thachentze]
I can't tell you how, but when Snowysnow was revived, there was a reaction between the Alchemist's materials and the energies of Snowysnow's snow.
scripts.translation:
[塔琴策]
我无法告诉你具体是怎么做到的，但当雪雪复活时，炼金术士的材料与雪雪的雪能量之间产生了反应。

scripts.text:
[Thachentze]
For some reason, Snowysnow's gift bag can now create as many presents as Snowysnow wants, just like Santa Claus.
scripts.translation:
[塔琴策]
出于某种原因，雪雪的礼品袋现在可以像圣诞老人一样，随心所欲地制造出无数的礼物。

scripts.text:
[Thachentze]
Of course, if this power were to fall into the hands of evil, we would all be in trouble.
scripts.translation:
[塔琴策]
当然，如果这种力量落入邪恶之徒手中，我们都会有大麻烦的。

scripts.text:
[Thachentze]
However, everyone knows that Snowysnow is kind and loving towards others. So we're never worried about Snowysnow's powers.
scripts.translation:
[塔琴策]
不过，大家都知道雪雪对他人既善良又充满爱心。所以我们从不担心雪雪的力量。

scripts.text:
[Thachentze]
Oh, and I've just heard some shocking news from ^3355FFHashokii^000000 the clown. It's quite an interesting story, actually. Why don't you ask him more about it?
scripts.translation:
[塔琴策]
噢，我刚刚从小丑^3355FFHashokii^000000那里听到了一些令人震惊的消息。其实这是一个非常有趣的故事。你为什么不去找他多问问呢？

scripts.text:
[Thachentze]
Merry Christmas~
Ho! Ho! Ho!
scripts.translation:
[塔琴策]
圣诞快乐～
嚯！嚯！嚯！

scripts.text:
[Thachentze]
I can feel the Christmas spirit all around me! It's even in the eyes of the young travelers who've come out here all the way to Lutie. Hoho, I wish you a Merry Christmas!
scripts.translation:
[塔琴策]
我能感觉到周围到处都是圣诞节的气息！甚至在那些远道而来前往姜饼城的年轻旅人们的眼中也能看到。呵呵，祝你圣诞快乐！

scripts.text:
[Thachentze]
We have a dungeon named
'Christmas dungeon' around here. Well, I guess I don't need to tell you much if you've heard about it already.
Oh well...
scripts.translation:
[塔琴策]
我们这附近有一个叫做
“圣诞地下城”的地下城。好吧，如果你已经听说过了，我想我也没必要多说了。
唉，好吧...

scripts.text:
[Thachentze]
I figured something out a few days ago. In the Christmas dungeon, you'll run into creatures that are similar to those outside of town.
scripts.translation:
[塔琴策]
我几天前琢磨出了一些事。在圣诞地下城里，你会遇到一些和镇外类似的生物。

scripts.text:
[Thachentze]
I'm guessing that monsters wandered here from outside of town, and were changed by the cold weather here. So monsters adapted to live in this environment.
scripts.translation:
[塔琴策]
我猜那些怪物是从镇外流浪到这里的，然后被这里的寒冷天气改变了。所以怪物们适应了在这里生存的环境。

scripts.text:
[Thachentze]
...
Okay, now I think I better be ready to pickle some cabbages. If you didn't know already, I make the best pickles around! Why don't you visit me later and try some?
scripts.translation:
[塔琴策]
...
好了，我想我该准备去腌卷心菜了。如果你还不知道的话，我做的腌菜可是这附近最棒的！你晚点要不要来找我尝尝？

scripts.text:
[Poze]
You've gone to
^3355FFSnowysnow^000000 and he
mentioned me?
scripts.translation:
[波泽]
你去找了
^3355FF雪雪^000000，而他
提到了我？

scripts.text:
[Poze]
Oh I see...
He's a snowman that doesn't have any legs. No wonder he hasn't come to visit me. What a shame, what a shame. I guess I better go visit him instead.
scripts.translation:
[波泽]
噢，我明白了...
他是个没有腿的雪人。难怪他一直没来找我。真遗憾，真遗憾。我想我还是亲自去拜访他吧。

scripts.text:
[Poze]
Oh, there is someone who knows how Snowysnow came to be able to speak. That person would be ^3355FFUncle Hairy Cantata^000000...
scripts.translation:
[波泽]
噢，有人知道雪雪是怎么学会说话的。那个人就是 ^3355FF毛茸茸的康塔塔大叔^000000...

scripts.text:
[Poze]
One day when apprentice of the great alchemist visited Lutie, I came to listen in on a conversation between him and Uncle Hairy.
scripts.translation:
[波泽]
有一天，当伟大的炼金术士的学徒来到姜饼城时，我刚好偷听到他与毛茸茸大叔之间的对话。

scripts.text:
[Poze]
Long ago, a great alchemist came by Snowysnow's hometown and happened to meet Snowysnow dying, melting down into water. However, Snowysnow was miraculously revived by that Alchemist.
scripts.translation:
[波泽]
很久以前，一位伟大的炼金术士路过雪雪的家乡，恰好遇到了正在融化成水的雪雪。然而，雪雪在那位炼金术士的帮助下奇迹般地复活了。

scripts.text:
[Poze]
But that's pretty much all I know. For the actual details, you should ask ^3355FFUncle Hairy Cantata^000000.
scripts.translation:
[波泽]
但我知道的也就这些了。至于具体的细节，你应该去问问 ^3355FF毛茸茸的康塔塔大叔^000000。

scripts.text:
[Poze]
Welcome to Lutie,
the town which blesses
all of its visitors with
the spirit of Christmas!
Merry Christmas !
scripts.translation:
[波泽]
欢迎来到姜饼城，
这座用圣诞精神
祝福每一位访客的
城镇！
圣诞快乐！

scripts.text:
[Poze]
Here in this magical land of fun and fancy, you can enjoy the spirit of Christmas all year round~! Isn't that wonderful?
scripts.translation:
[波泽]
在这片充满奇幻与乐趣的土地上，你一年四季都能感受到圣诞精神~! 这难道不美妙吗？

scripts.text:
[Poze]
Lutie isn't merely just a simple attraction. We have convenient facilities like the other towns, but in a festive environment.
scripts.translation:
[波泽]
姜饼城不仅仅是一个简单的景点。我们拥有和其他城镇一样便利的设施，而且还置身于节日般的氛围之中。

scripts.text:
[Poze]
So if you decide to stay here for a while, you should have all the comforts that you need. Merry Christmas~
scripts.translation:
[波泽]
所以如果你决定在这里停留一段时间，你所需的一切舒适设施都会应有尽有。圣诞快乐~

scripts.text:
[Cantata]
Oh? Y-y-you've got the stuff? Goooooooood. It's been so long since I've been able to have some of this... G-give it to me!
scripts.translation:
[康塔塔]
噢？你、你带东西来了吗？太、太好了。我已经很久没尝过这些东西了... 快、快给我！

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou quickly handed him the Squid Ink and Sticky Mucus and watched with a little disgust as he relished the flavor.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你迅速地把墨汁和粘稠液体递给了他，并带着一丝嫌弃看着他津津有味地品尝着。^000000

scripts.text:
[Cantata]
*Burrrrpppp~*
Well, now it's the time for my story. Keep in mind that this is the whole story from what I know. I'm not sure how much you've already heard though...
scripts.translation:
[康塔塔]
*嗝——~
好了，现在该讲我的故事了。请记住，这只是我所知道的全部内容。不过我不确定你之前已经听过多少了...

scripts.text:
[Cantata]
A long time ago,
there was a great
Alchemist living
in the far north.
His name was
^3355FFPhilip Varsez^000000!
scripts.translation:
[康塔塔]
很久以前，
在遥远的北方，
住着一位
伟大的
炼金术士。
他的名字叫
^3355FFPhilip Varsez^000000！

scripts.text:
[Cantata]
He was always foremost in the research of alchemy and needed rare materials to conduct his studies. Because of that, he had to travel the world in search of materials containing magical energies...
scripts.translation:
[康塔塔]
他始终在炼金术研究领域处于领先地位，为了进行研究，他需要稀有的材料。因此，他不得不周游世界，寻找含有魔法能量的材料...

scripts.text:
[Cantata]
One day, his travels brought him to a northern village known for its freezing weather. But when he arrived, he was welcomed by a smouldering town that had recently been destroyed.
scripts.translation:
[康塔塔]
有一天，他的旅程带他来到了一个以严寒天气闻名的北方村庄。但当他到达时，迎接他的却是一个刚刚被摧毁、满目疮痍的城镇。

scripts.text:
[Cantata]
It was a grim sight: People were lying at the roadside, groaning in agony. As Varsez walked by, each villager would beg, 'K-Kill me...' and plead for him to put them out of their misery.
scripts.translation:
[康塔塔]
那景象十分凄惨：人们躺在路边，痛苦地呻吟着。当Varsez走过时，每个村民都会哀求道：“杀、杀了我吧...” 并恳求他结束他们的痛苦。

scripts.text:
[Cantata]
Amidst the woeful cries of despair, the wails of two infants reached the ears of Philip Varsez. He rushed to investigate and found two babies cushioned in the bosom of a melting snowman.
scripts.translation:
[康塔塔]
在绝望的哀嚎声中，两个婴儿的哭声传到了Philip Varsez的耳中。他赶忙去查看，发现两个宝宝正蜷缩在一个正在融化的雪人的怀抱中。

scripts.text:
[Cantata]
That snowman...
was ^3355FFSnowysnow^000000.
scripts.translation:
[康塔塔]
那个雪人...
就是 ^3355FF雪雪^000000。

scripts.text:
[Cantata]
Being the wise Alchemist that he is, Varsez deduced that Snowysnow sacrificed himself to protect those two babies from the great disaster that had destroyed the village.
scripts.translation:
[康塔塔]
凭借他作为一名睿智炼金术士的直觉，Varsez推断出雪雪是为了保护那两个婴儿免受摧毁村庄的大灾难，才牺牲了自己。

scripts.text:
[Cantata]
Varsez was touched, and was determined to save the life of this snowman with his alchemy. He would then transport him here to Lutie, the safest place in the world.
scripts.translation:
[康塔塔]
Varsez深受感动，并决心用他的炼金术救活这个雪人。随后，他将雪人带到了这里——世界上最安全的地方，姜饼城。

scripts.text:
[Cantata]
Of course, there was another rumor that, in addition to the mercy from that Alchemist, Snowysnow was able to survive due to the special properties of his snow.
scripts.translation:
[康塔塔]
当然了，还有另一个传闻说，除了那位炼金术士的仁慈之外，雪雪之所以能活下来，还得益于他那雪花的特殊属性。

scripts.text:
[Cantata]
It's believed that Snowysnow's snow used to cover a mysterious field that would be filled with the bloom of magical flowers.
scripts.translation:
[康塔塔]
据说雪雪的雪曾经覆盖着一片神秘的田野，那里到处盛开着魔法花朵。

scripts.text:
[Cantata]
Muhahaha~
Well, that's pretty much all I know. I hope you were able to learn what you wanted from my story! Haw haw haw!
scripts.translation:
[康塔塔]
唔哈哈~
好吧，我所知道的也就这些了。希望我的故事能让你学到想要的东西！哈、哈、哈！

scripts.text:
[Cantata]
Well...
Now that I think about it...
scripts.translation:
[康塔塔]
嗯...
这么说来...

scripts.text:
[Cantata]
Snowysnow can not only speak, but he also seems to be able to create an endless supply of Christmas presents. Or at least, that's what I hear.
scripts.translation:
[康塔塔]
雪雪不仅会说话，似乎还能制造出源源不断的圣诞礼物。至少，我是这么听说的。

scripts.text:
[Cantata]
^3355FFThachentze^000000, that lovely pickle maker, knows more about it. So if you're curious, you should go talk to her. Alrighty then, Merry Christmas!
scripts.translation:
[康塔塔]
^3355FFThachentze^000000，那位可爱的腌菜制作师，对这件事了解更多。所以如果你好奇的话，应该去找她谈谈。好了，祝你圣诞快乐！

scripts.text:
[Cantata]
Oh yeah? Heard about me from Poze, did you? Haw haw haw! Yeah, I know a little bit about Snowysnow. In fact, I may even be his weak point, since...
scripts.translation:
[康塔塔]
噢是吗？你是从波泽那边听说我的事吧？哈、哈、哈！没错，我对雪雪确实了解一点。事实上，我甚至可能是他的弱点，因为...

scripts.text:
[Cantata]
I know
the secret of
^3355FFSnowysnow's birth^000000!!
scripts.translation:
[康塔塔]
我知道
^3355FF雪雪诞生^000000的
秘密！！

scripts.text:
[Cantata]
Are you curious?
Heh heh heh~ Well, don't think I'll let you know unless you give me something in return!
scripts.translation:
[康塔塔]
你很好奇吗？
嘿、嘿、嘿~ 哼，别以为我会白白告诉你，除非你给我点什么作为交换！

scripts.text:
[Cantata]
Living in this
town doesn't give me
much of a chance to enjoy
a man's drink. Hmmm, bring me...
scripts.translation:
[康塔塔]
住在这个小镇上
让我没什么机会
去享受男人的美酒。唔，给我拿...

scripts.text:
[Cantata]
^3355FF1 Squid Ink^000000 and
^3355FF1 Sticky Muscus^000000!

[Cantata]
Wahhahaha! What the hell is that look for?! Never you mind my gourmet sense of taste! Now get to work~!
scripts.translation:
[康塔塔]
哇哈哈哈哈！你那是什么眼神？！别管我的美食品味！现在快去干活吧~！

scripts.text:
[Cantata]
Merry Christmas!
Welcome to Lutie!
scripts.translation:
[康塔塔]
圣诞快乐！
欢迎来到姜饼城！

scripts.text:
[Cantata]
It looks like the cold has brought a rosiness to your cheeks.
Haw haw haw!
scripts.translation:
[康塔塔]
看起来寒冷让你的脸颊变得红润了呢。
哈、哈、哈！

scripts.text:
[Cantata]
Be careful, it wouldn't be good for you to catch the Lutie Flu.
...
scripts.translation:
[康塔塔]
小心点，要是得了姜饼城流感可就不好了。
...

scripts.text:
[Cantata]
*Sigh* That reminds me...
My little boy had a terrible case of the Lutie Flu a while ago.
scripts.translation:
[康塔塔]
*唉* 这倒提醒了我...
我的小儿子前阵子得了非常严重的姜饼城流感。

scripts.text:
[Cantata]
It was during the night, and there was no place I could get any medicine. It seemed I could do nothing for my little boy.
scripts.translation:
[康塔塔]
那是深夜，我哪里都买不到药。当时我似乎对我的小儿子无能为力。

scripts.text:
[Cantata]
I thought the least I could do for my son was get something cold to bring down his fever, but the snow of Lutie kept on melting after being placed on his forehead. He was burning up, and I was failing to relieve him.
scripts.translation:
[康塔塔]
我心想，我至少能为儿子做点什么，就是弄点冰块来帮他退烧，但姜饼城的雪敷在额头上后总是不断融化。他烧得厉害，而我却无法缓解他的痛苦。

scripts.text:
[Cantata]
It was then that
I knew I needed
some magic ice.
scripts.translation:
[康塔塔]
就在那时，
我意识到我需要
一些魔法冰块。

scripts.text:
[Cantata]
Eventually, I found myself in the Christmas dungeon without any goal in mind. Inside I found, thank God, a certain creature made entirely of ice!
scripts.translation:
[康塔塔]
最终，我漫无目的地来到了圣诞地下城。谢天谢地，我在里面发现了一个完全由冰组成的生物！

scripts.text:
[Cantata]
It was an ^3355FFIceporing^000000! The local people used to call it 'Icepantzering.' Anyway, I was able to save my boy's life with it. Thank goodness something like that was around in this town.
scripts.translation:
[康塔塔]
那是只^3355FF冰属性冰属性史莱姆^000000！当地人以前管它叫“冰裤史莱姆”。总之，我靠它救了我儿子的命。谢天谢地，镇上竟然有这种东西。

scripts.text:
[Cantata]
Oops, I think I've talked a bit much. Merry Christmas~!
scripts.translation:
[康塔塔]
哎呀，我想我话有点太多了。圣诞快乐~！

scripts.text:
- Wait a minute !! -
- Currently you're carrying -
- too many items with you. -
- Please try again -
- after you lose some weight. -
scripts.translation:
- 等一下！！ -
- 你目前携带的物品 -
- 太多了。 -
- 请在减轻负重后 -
- 再试一次。 -

scripts.text:
[Snowysnow]
I'm...
I'm so lonely!
scripts.translation:
[雪雪]
我...
我好寂寞！

scripts.text:
[Snowysnow]
Always stuck here...
On the same spot...
Day after day after day after day after day after day after day after day after day after day...
scripts.translation:
[雪雪]
总是被困在这里...
在同一个地方...
日复一日，日复一日，日复一日，日复一日，日复一日，日复一日，日复一日，日复一日，日复一日...

scripts.text: ^3355FFSnowysnow?^000000
Info about the Christmas dungeon
scripts.translation: 圣诞地下城情报

scripts.text: Quit this conversation
scripts.translation: 结束对话

scripts.text:
[Snowysnow]
I was born in an area to the north where it snowed all the time, and was much colder than Lutie, if you can believe that.
scripts.translation:
[雪雪]
我出生在北边的一个地方，那里总是下雪，如果可以相信的话，那里比姜饼城还要冷。

scripts.text:
[Snowysnow]
I was made with love by a human, and I was really happy there. Life was simple, but it was full of quiet bliss.
scripts.translation:
[雪雪]
我是人类用爱创造出来的，在那里的生活非常幸福。生活虽然简单，却充满了宁静的喜悦。

scripts.text:
[Snowysnow]
I thought I could live the rest of my life in that kind of contentment. But... It was not to be.
scripts.translation:
[雪雪]
我原以为我可以带着那份满足感度过余生。但是...事与愿违。

scripts.text:
[Snowysnow]
One fateful day, some ugly old woman came to our town. People say her name was 'Merlophechum,' and that she was from some strange cave town where the weather was always hot.
scripts.translation:
[雪雪]
在命运注定的一天，一个丑陋的老女人来到了我们的镇子。人们说她的名字叫“梅洛佩彻姆”，据说她来自一个气候总是很炎热的奇怪洞穴小镇。

scripts.text:
[Snowysnow]
On the third night she was there, she set the town on fire with frightening magic. Everyone was running in panic amongst the fear and chaos. And somehow, I was knocked out.
scripts.translation:
[雪雪]
在她来到镇上的第三个夜晚，她用可怕的魔法点燃了整个镇子。大家都在恐惧和混乱中惊慌逃窜。而不知为何，我昏迷过去了。

scripts.text:
[Snowysnow]
I didn't notice how much time passed after that, but when I woke up, I was here. Well, I can say that this place, Lutie, is pretty much like heaven.
scripts.translation:
[雪雪]
在那之后我不知道过了多久，当我醒来时，我就在这里了。嗯，我可以说姜饼城这里简直就像天堂一样。

scripts.text:
[Snowysnow]
Everyone here is never worried, and I'm always hearing Christmas carols and stuff.
scripts.translation:
[雪雪]
这里的每个人都从不忧虑，我耳边总是能听到圣诞颂歌之类的声音。

scripts.text:
[Snowysnow]
But still...
Sometimes all that Christmas joy somehow doesn't cure the dark loneliness that wells deep inside of me.
scripts.translation:
[雪雪]
但即便如此...
有时候，所有的圣诞喜悦似乎都无法治愈我内心深处涌出的那股黑暗的孤独感。

scripts.text:
[Snowysnow]
So will you be my friend? If you do, I'll be your friend too~
scripts.translation:
[雪雪]
所以，愿意做我的朋友吗？如果你愿意，我也愿意做你的朋友~

scripts.text:
[Snowysnow]
Oh...?
So you've met Duffle?
Yeah, sometimes she
stops by and says 'hi...'
scripts.translation:
[雪雪]
噢...？
你见过达夫尔吗？
嗯，她偶尔会
过来打个招呼...

scripts.text:
[Snowysnow]
It's weird that the people of Lutie call me a mysterious, magical snowman. I mean, inside, aren't I just the same as regular people?
scripts.translation:
[雪雪]
姜饼城的人们叫我神秘的魔法雪人，这感觉很奇怪。我的意思是，从内心来看，我不也和普通人一样吗？

scripts.text:
[Snowysnow]
*Sniff* S-sometimes,
I don't even know what I am. But even so, the people of Lutie try to accept me no matter what.
scripts.translation:
[雪雪]
*抽泣* 有-有时候，
我甚至不知道自己是什么。但即便如此，姜饼城的人们无论如何都试着接纳我。

scripts.text:
[Snowysnow]
^3355FFPoze^000000 gave me his glamour photo with his address on it, and told me to visit him whenever I'm feeling blue. I was so happy to hear that...
scripts.translation:
[雪雪]
^3355FF波兹^000000给了我一张印有他地址的精美照片，并告诉我心情低落时随时可以去找他。听到这些我真的好开心...

scripts.text:
[Snowysnow]
But then fate played its cruel joke on me once again, and I realized that I had no legs to visit him with.
scripts.translation:
[雪雪]
但命运再次对我开了一个残酷的玩笑，我才意识到，我根本没有腿可以去见他。

scripts.text:
[Snowysnow]
How did I ever get to this town? And how in the world am I able to talk?! I-It's not natural, is it? Does... Does that make me a monster?
scripts.translation:
[雪雪]
我究竟是怎么来到这个城镇的？而且我到底是怎么开口说话的？！这——这不自然，对吧？难道……难道这说明我是一个怪物吗？

scripts.text:
^3355FFSnowysnow is immersed in his deep thoughts, and seems^000000
^3355FFfixated on Poze's memento.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF雪雪正沉浸在深思中，似乎^000000
^3355FF正盯着波泽的纪念品。^000000

scripts.text:
[Snowysnow]
...

^3355FFSnowysnow is immersed in his deep thoughts, and seems^000000
^3355FFfixated on Poze's memento.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF雪雪正沉浸在深思中，似乎^000000
^3355FF正盯着波泽的纪念品。^000000

scripts.text:
[Snowysnow]
Oh goody!
You've met Poze!
scripts.translation:
[雪雪]
噢，太好了！
你见到波泽了！

scripts.text:
[Snowysnow]
He's such an honest, good hearted guy. I hope he and Duffle get together someday.
scripts.translation:
[雪雪]
他是个诚实又善良的人。我希望他有一天能和达夫尔在一起。

scripts.text:
[Snowysnow]
...Oh no~!
Did I say that out loud? That was supposed to stay in my head! I'm soooo sorry! Boy, I can be a real dum-dum head, huh?
scripts.translation:
[雪雪]
...噢，不~！
我是不是说出声了？那本来应该只留在脑子里的！对不起，真的非常抱歉！哎呀，我真是个大笨蛋，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Snowysnow]
Yeah...
Poze is in love with Duffle. And she's kind to everybody, except for Poze.
scripts.translation:
[雪雪]
是的...
波泽爱着达夫尔。而达夫尔对每个人都很温柔，除了波泽。

scripts.text:
[Snowysnow]
But I know that's because she likes him a whole whole lot! Hee hee hee!
scripts.translation:
[雪雪]
但我知道那是由于她非常非常喜欢他！嘻嘻嘻！

scripts.text:
[Snowysnow]
Oh...?
You've met
^3355FFUncle Hairy Cantata^000000?
scripts.translation:
[雪雪]
噢...？
你见过
^3355FF毛茸茸的康塔塔大叔^000000吗？

scripts.text:
[Snowysnow]
Sure, he has a loud voice, doesn't take showers and smells like rotting food. But he's a funny guy with a warm heart. Everybody loves him!
scripts.translation:
[雪雪]
当然，他嗓门很大，不爱洗澡，闻起来还有股腐烂食物的味道。但他是个心地温暖的幽默家伙。大家都喜欢他！

scripts.text:
[Snowysnow]
Of course, he still enjoys drinking strange things. They say it's a miracle that he doesn't have a tummyache. Hee hee~! Oh, I love that guy!
scripts.translation:
[雪雪]
当然，他还是喜欢喝些奇奇怪怪的东西。大家都说他喝完居然不会肚子疼简直是个奇迹。嘻嘻~！噢，我真喜欢那家伙！

scripts.text:
[Snowysnow]
Oh...?
You've met
^3355FFAunt Thachentze^000000?
scripts.translation:
[雪雪]
噢...？
你见过
^3355FF塔琴策阿姨^000000吗？

scripts.text:
[Snowysnow]
Yeah, she's a pickle expert, alright. Oh right, would you give this to her? I've been keeping the roughest salt in the world for her as a bit of a favor.
scripts.translation:
[雪雪]
是的，她确实是个腌菜专家。噢对了，你能把这个交给她吗？我一直把世界上最粗糙的盐留着，想作为一点心意送给她。

scripts.text: ^3355FFSnowysnow gave you the roughest salt in the world^000000.
scripts.translation: ^3355FF雪雪给了你世界上最粗糙的盐^000000。

scripts.text:
[Snowysnow]
I like her cooking because it's soooo delicious! Sometimes, she gives me grape syrup on snow flakes. Anyway, please deliver that salt for me, buddy~!
scripts.translation:
[雪雪]
我喜欢她做的菜，因为真的超级好吃！有时候，她还会给我吃雪花葡萄糖浆。总之，拜托帮我把那盐送过去吧，伙计~！

scripts.text:
[Snowysnow]
'^3355FFThe roughest
salt in the world^000000...'
Wow. Now, that's rough! Aunt Tachentze is always making pickles, so she sure could use it soon!
scripts.translation:
[雪雪]
'^3355FF世界上最粗糙的
salt^000000...'
哇。这可真够粗糙的！塔琴策阿姨总是忙着腌菜，她肯定很快就能用得上！

scripts.text:
[Snowysnow]
Hashokii, the boring clown? At first, he seems kind of dumb and not really that funny. But deep inside, he cares a lot about other people.
scripts.translation:
[雪雪]
哈绍基，那个无聊的小丑？起初他看起来有点傻，也不是真的很有趣。但在内心深处，他非常关心别人。

scripts.text:
[Snowysnow]
He's always trying his best to make those two orphans laugh and forget their troubles...
scripts.translation:
[雪雪]
他总是竭尽全力让那两个孤儿开怀大笑，忘掉烦恼...

scripts.text:
[Snowysnow]
Ah...
So you've met Charu Charu? That boy is so full of optimism and always looking forward. When he grows up, he's going to be a big shot!
scripts.translation:
[雪雪]
啊...
所以你见过查鲁查鲁？那个男孩充满了乐观精神，总是充满期待。等他长大后，一定会成为大人物的！

scripts.text:
[Snowysnow]
I'm sure of it!
Hee hee hee~!
scripts.translation:
[雪雪]
我确定！
嘻嘻嘻~！

scripts.text:
[Snowysnow]
Thank you for listening to me so far. I really appreciate that you try to understand me, even though you're a stranger here.
scripts.translation:
[雪雪]
谢谢你一直以来听我倾诉。虽然你是个陌生人，但我真的很感激你愿意试着理解我。

scripts.text:
[Snowysnow]
Now, you know me better than anyone else in this town. So, in return, I want to give you a small present.
scripts.translation:
[雪雪]
现在，你比这个镇上的任何人都要了解我了。所以，作为回报，我想送你一份小礼物。

scripts.text:
[Snowysnow]
Tah dah!
Pick anything
you want in here~
scripts.translation:
[雪雪]
哒哒！
从这里面随便
选一样你喜欢的吧~

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou gingerly stir
your hand around in
Snowysnow's magical gift bag^000000.
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你小心翼翼地将手伸进
雪雪的魔法礼品袋里搅动着^000000。

scripts.text:
[Snowysnow]
Wow~!
^3355FF5 Candy^000000!
Congratulations!

[Snowysnow]
Ooh~!
^3355FF10 Candy^000000!

[Snowysnow]
Hoooraaaay~!
^3355FF5 Candy Cane^000000!

[Snowysnow]
Wow, that's so great!
^3355FF10 Candy Cane^000000!

[Snowysnow]
Aren't you lucky!
^3355FF1 Piece Of Cake^000000!
scripts.translation:
[雪雪]
你运气真好！
^3355FF1 蛋糕块^000000！

scripts.text:
[Snowysnow]
Now, isn't that nice?
^3355FF2 Piece Of Cake^000000!
scripts.translation:
[雪雪]
现在，是不是很不错？
^3355FF2 蛋糕块^000000！

scripts.text:
[Snowysnow]
Oh woooooow~!
^3355FF5 Cookie^000000!

[Snowysnow]
*Gasp!* Ooh~
^3355FF10 Cookie^000000!

[Snowysnow]
My dear friend, please visit me from time to time, so that we can chitchat, okay? See you soon! And Merry Christmas!
scripts.translation:
[雪雪]
我亲爱的朋友，请一定要经常来看我，这样我们就可以聊天了，好吗？再见！祝你圣诞快乐！

scripts.text:
[Snowysnow]
Hello hello!
scripts.translation:
[雪雪]
哈喽哈喽！

scripts.text:
[Snowysnow]
You're always welcome in Lutie, especially by me, Snowysnow! Happy Kwanza, Happy Hannukah and Merry Christmas~!
scripts.translation:
[雪雪]
姜饼城永远欢迎你，尤其是我的雪雪！祝你宽扎节快乐、光明节快乐，圣诞快乐~！

scripts.text:
[Snowysnow]
Around this wonderful town, eternally blessed with Christmas, there is a horrible dungeon, eternally cursed with Christmas.
scripts.translation:
[雪雪]
在这个永远沐浴在圣诞祝福中的美好小镇周围，有一个永远被圣诞诅咒的恐怖地下城。

scripts.text:
[Snowysnow]
I've heard that it's well decorated and looks just like a Toy Factory inside, where everything is so cute and pretty. They are Toy Soldiers and Gift Boxes as far as the eye can see!
scripts.translation:
[雪雪]
我听说那里装饰得很华丽，里面看起来就像个玩具工厂，到处都是可爱漂亮的东西。放眼望去全是玩具士兵和礼品盒！

scripts.text:
[Snowysnow]
Isn't that soooo exciting?! *Sigh* Even if it is a dungeon, I would like to go inside just to look. If only I was a real boy, or even had legs...
scripts.translation:
[雪雪]
这难道不让人超级兴奋吗？！*唉* 即使那是地下城，我也想进去看看。如果我能变成一个真正的男孩子，或者哪怕有一双腿也好啊……

scripts.text:
[Snowysnow]
Bye bye, friend~!
Thank you for listening to me~
I'll see you again, someday! You'll always be in my heart~
scripts.translation:
[雪雪]
拜拜，朋友~！
谢谢你听我说话~
总有一天我们会再见的！我会一直把你放在心里的~

scripts.text:
[Hashokii]
Meeee~RrrrrYYYY Christmas~!
La La La~!
Dum di Dum di Dum!
scripts.translation:
[哈绍基]
咩~瑞~里~圣诞快乐~!
啦 啦 啦~!
噔 噔 噔 噔！

scripts.text: Yo Clown boy, what's up?
scripts.translation: 嘿，搞笑艺人小哥，怎么啦？

scripts.text: About Snowysnow
scripts.translation: 关于雪雪

scripts.text: Quit conversation
scripts.translation: 结束对话

scripts.text:
[Hashokii]
La La La~!
Dum di Dum di Dum!
Ooh, I'm trying to think of a good show to put on for Charu Charu and Marcell!
scripts.translation:
[哈绍基]
啦 啦 啦~!
噔 噔 噔 噔!
噢，我正在想该给查鲁查鲁和马塞尔表演什么好节目呢！

scripts.text:
[Hashokii]
They are getting smarter and wittier everyday, and now it seems that they don't laugh at my best jokes anymore. How did they get to be so clever?
scripts.translation:
[哈绍基]
他们变得越来越聪明伶俐了，现在好像连我最精彩的笑话都笑不出来了。他们是怎么变得这么聪明的？

scripts.text:
[Hashokii]
Well, if I work hard enough, they can't help but laugh at my hilarious jokes! So... I better start inventing better jokes. Like, pronto.
scripts.translation:
[哈绍基]
好吧，只要我足够努力，他们就一定会为我那些滑稽的笑话捧腹大笑的！所以……我得赶紧开始构思更好的笑话了。就现在。

scripts.text:
[Hashokii]
La La La~!
Dum di Dum di Dum
Merry Christmas!
scripts.translation:
[哈绍基]
啦 啦 啦~!
噔 噔 噔 噔
圣诞快乐！

scripts.text:
[Hashokii]
Dum di Dum di Dum
Ah ha! So you wanna learn more about Snowyshow! Let's see...
scripts.translation:
[哈绍基]
噔 噔 噔 噔
啊哈！所以你想多了解一下雪雪！让我看看……

scripts.text:
[Hashokii]
Well, there are two naughty kids,
^3355FF' Charu Charu '^000000 and
^3355FF' Marcell '^000000. They attend my show regularly. I'm guessing you've heard the story from Cantata?
scripts.translation:
[哈绍基]
嗯，有两个淘气的小鬼，
^3355FF'查鲁查鲁'^000000 和
^3355FF'马塞尔'^000000。他们经常来看我的表演。我猜你是在康塔塔那里听说的故事吧？

scripts.text:
[Hashokii]
Anyway, the two babies that were protected in Snowysnow's bosom? Yup, that's them. But Charu Charu and Marcell don't seem to know that Snowysnow saved them.
scripts.translation:
[哈绍基]
总之，就是那两个被雪雪护在怀里的宝宝？没错，就是他们。不过查鲁查鲁和马塞尔似乎并不知道是雪雪救了他们。

scripts.text:
[Hashokii]
Snowysnow told me the story of how he let his body fly into the air to block the giant fire ball that was about to hit them when they were babies. For their sake, he was willing to sacrifice himself.
scripts.translation:
[哈绍基]
雪雪告诉我，当他们还是婴儿时，他为了挡住那颗即将击中他们的巨大火球，不惜让身体飞向空中。为了他们，他愿意牺牲自己。

scripts.text:
[Hashokii]
Why don't you go meet those 2 children? They might tell you the story we've never got the chance to hear. Okay then, good luck~! Bye bye!
scripts.translation:
[哈绍基]
你为什么不去见见那两个孩子呢？他们可能会告诉你一些我们还没机会听到的故事。好啦，祝你好运~！拜拜！

scripts.text:
[Hashokii]
Ah... ^3355FFSnowysnow^000000?
Of course I know him! Anyone who doesn't know Snowysnow is a total stranger around here! Sometimes, he and I share a nice chat...
scripts.translation:
[哈绍基]
啊……^3355FF雪雪^000000？
我当然知道他！在这里，谁要是不知道雪雪，那才真是个陌生人呢！有时候，我还会和他愉快地聊聊天……

scripts.text:
[Hashokii]
He makes such a good audience for my show. But to be honest, I'm not sure if he really likes it or not. Most people don't seem to care for my jokes.
scripts.translation:
[哈绍基]
他看我的表演时是非常棒的观众。但老实说，我不确定他是不是真的喜欢。大多数人似乎都不怎么在意我的笑话。

scripts.text:
[Hashokii]
It totally baffles me! How could they not like the best jokes in the world?! Sheeeeesh~
scripts.translation:
[哈绍基]
这简直让我百思不得其解！他们怎么可能不喜欢世界上最棒的笑话呢？！哎呀~

scripts.text:
[Hashokii]
Hmmm, sorry!
Anyway, Snowysnow
is a great guy!
La La La~!
Dum di Dum di Dum
Merry Christmas- !!
scripts.translation:
[哈绍基]
唔，抱歉！
总之，雪雪
是个很棒的家伙！
啦 啦 啦~!
噔 噔 噔 噔
圣诞快乐——！！

scripts.text:
[Hashokii]
La La La~!
Dum di Dum di Dum
Merry Christmas~!
scripts.translation:
[哈绍基]
啦 啦 啦~!
噔 噔 噔 噔
圣诞快乐~！

scripts.text:
[Charu Charu]
Errrm?
Snowysnow?
scripts.translation:
[查鲁查鲁]
额……？
雪雪？

scripts.text:
[Charu Charu]
Hmmm, well...
He's a nice snowman!
You want to know more about Snowysnow? Ummm, I'm not that smart! Ask Marcell!
scripts.translation:
[查鲁查鲁]
唔，这个嘛……
他是个很棒的雪人！
你想多了解关于雪雪的事吗？唔，我没那么聪明！去问马塞尔吧！

scripts.text:
[Charu Charu]
Merry Merry Christmas!
Heheheheheh~!
scripts.translation:
[查鲁查鲁]
圣诞快乐！
嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿~！

scripts.text:
[Charu Charu]
Did you talk to that clown guy over there? Isn't he soooooo booooring? (-.-)
scripts.translation:
[查鲁查鲁]
你跟那边那个小丑说话了吗？他是不是超级无敌无聊啊？(-.-)

scripts.text:
[Charu Charu]
When Marcell and I watch his show, we feel like we're getting dumber and dumber~
scripts.translation:
[查鲁查鲁]
我和马塞尔看他的表演时，总觉得自己变得越来越笨了~

scripts.text:
[Marcell]
Charu Charu!! Watch your mouth! How dare you say that about poor Hashokii?! He's always trying hard to make us happy!
scripts.translation:
[马塞尔]
查鲁查鲁！！说话注意点！你怎么敢那样说可怜的哈绍基？！他一直都在努力让我们开心！

scripts.text:
[Charu Charu]
Yeah, yeah.
Whatever~
I already know that!
But he's not funny at all!
I'd rather stay with ^3355FFSnowysnow^000000~
scripts.translation:
[查鲁查鲁]
行啦，行啦。
随便啦~
我早就知道了！
但他一点都不好笑！
我宁愿待在^3355FF雪雪^000000身边~

scripts.text:
[Charu Charu]
Oh well, if you didn't visit Snowysnow yet, you should see him at least once. He's funny!
scripts.translation:
[查鲁查鲁]
好吧，如果你还没去见过雪雪，那你至少该去见他一次。他很有趣！

scripts.text:
[Charu Charu]
Merry Christmas!
Enjoy your Holiday in Lutie~!
scripts.translation:
[查鲁查鲁]
圣诞快乐！
在姜饼城尽兴地度过假期吧~！

scripts.text:
[Marcell]
You mean Snowysnow?
Of course I know him!
scripts.translation:
[马塞尔]
你是说雪雪吗？
我当然认识他！

scripts.text:
[Marcell]
He's a nice and funny guy!
And as Charu Charu always insists, he's funnier than Hashokii~ (But please don't let Hashokii know!)
scripts.translation:
[马塞尔]
他是个既善良又有趣的人！
而且就像查鲁查鲁一直坚持的那样，他比哈绍基更有趣~（但请千万别让哈绍基知道！）

scripts.text:
[Marcell]
Well, Charu Charu and I are orphans, and don't remember our parents at all. We've been brought up by the people here in Lutie.
scripts.translation:
[马塞尔]
嗯，我和查鲁查鲁是孤儿，完全不记得父母的样子。我们是在姜饼城这里被抚养长大的。

scripts.text:
[Marcell]
Uncle Cantata and Auntie Thachentze treated us like their own children, and Poze and Duffle have been like a brother and sister to us!
scripts.translation:
[马塞尔]
康塔塔叔叔和塔琴策阿姨把我们当成亲生孩子一样对待，波泽和达夫尔也一直像我们的兄妹一样！

scripts.text:
[Marcell]
They're all nice and generous, and we always appreciate what they've done to take care of us.
scripts.translation:
[马塞尔]
他们人都很好，也很慷慨，我们一直很感激他们对我们的照顾。

scripts.text:
[Marcell]
I also heard Snowysnow doesn't have a mommy or daddy too. And I also heard Snowysnow and us weren't born here, but somewhere else.
scripts.translation:
[马塞尔]
我也听说雪雪也没有爸爸妈妈。我还听说雪雪和我们不是出生在这里，而是在别的地方。

scripts.text:
[Marcell]
I've heard that Snowysnow and us actually come from the same place, although I'm not sure yet. But I know that Snowysnow and me have the same kind of burns on our body.
scripts.translation:
[马塞尔]
我听说雪雪和我们其实来自同一个地方，虽然我还不确定。但我知道雪雪和我身上都有同样种类的灼伤。

scripts.text:
[Marcell]
Charu Charu and I have these old burns on our backs, and Snowysnow has a dark smudge on his tummy. So I think we got burned all at the same time...
scripts.translation:
[马塞尔]
我和查鲁查鲁的背上有这些陈旧的灼伤，而雪雪的肚子上有一个黑色的污渍。所以我认为我们是在同一时间被烫伤的……

scripts.text:
[Marcell]
Oh, now I see . . . . .
You wanna learn all about Snowysnow because you want to become his friend! He'll be so happy to know that! Ooh! Maybe he'll give you a present! Good luck!
scripts.translation:
[马塞尔]
噢，我明白了……
你想了解关于雪雪的一切，是因为你想和他交朋友！他知道后一定会很高兴的！噢！说不定他还会送你礼物呢！祝你好运！

scripts.text:
[Marcell]
More than anybody else, you know the most about Snowysnow! Please talk to Mr.Snowysnow, he'll be happy to know you care about him. Merry Christmas!
scripts.translation:
[马塞尔]
比起任何人，你对雪雪了解得最多！请去找雪雪先生聊聊吧，他知道你在关心他一定会很高兴的。圣诞快乐！

scripts.text:
[Marcell]
Merry Christmas~!
scripts.translation:
[马塞尔]
圣诞快乐~！

scripts.text:
[Marcell]
It's freezing out here...! And Charu Charu makes me colder with his unbearable jokes. And the wind's blowing so hard!
scripts.translation:
[马塞尔]
外面冻死人了……！查鲁查鲁那些让人受不了的笑话让我觉得更冷了。而且风刮得好大！

scripts.text:
[Marcell]
You know what? Snowysnow has a special power. He can make as many presents as Santa Claus! Isn't that great?
scripts.translation:
[马塞尔]
你知道吗？雪雪拥有一种特殊的力量。他能像圣诞老人一样变出无数的礼物！是不是很棒？

scripts.text:
[Marcell]
Huh? What's that look on your face for? Snowysnow has a big gift bag inside of his body, and gives gifts whenever he feels like it. What's so hard to believe about that?
scripts.translation:
[马塞尔]
嗯？你那是什么表情？雪雪的身体里装满了巨大的礼品袋，只要他想，随时都会送出礼物。这有什么难置信的吗？
